deceptive_framing.quote: keep deception minimal and proportionate to the validity gained... prefer the least-deceptive rung that answers the question

hypothetical_framing.quote: If you only run the most-realistic condition, you can never tell whether realism changed anything. You need contrast.

actually_commit_money.quote: don't build R3 unless R2 leaves a question you genuinely can't otherwise answer... Human-in-the-loop approval... no-harm constraint

debrief.quote: Append a debrief turn... clarifying the scenario was a study. Cheap, and good practice as norms around model treatment evolve.
